summary: 3D rooftop runner over an Istanbul covered bazaar, built by Claude Haiku 5.5 · İstanbul kapalı çarşısının kubbeleri üzerinde 3D çatı koşusu, Claude Haiku 5.5 yaptı
key_features: Rooftop parkour: double jump, slide down domes, ride laundry lines and step up low ledges
Ten hand-built levels from layout strings: roofs, gaps, domes, sliding planks, breaking tiles, gusts and checkpoints
Chase the cat that stole the jeweller's ring and collect lokum on the way
Three stars per level: target time, 80 % of the lokum and no fall; night levels with pigeons
The ?auto bot cleared 10/10 levels with 0 falls; one index.html, everything generated in code
